methodology.order: small base/incremental, medium base/incremental, large base/incremental; then small/medium/large final; then full parity and three cache repairs per engine
methodology.fresh: absent Catalog; OS caches are not flushed
methodology.query: five maintained showcase query routes, complete bounded continuation pages; warm-phase median reported separately
methodology.input: targeted Enhanced Input decode during fresh scenario only
methodology.memory: sampled process RSS, not guaranteed peak; null means short Rust process not observed
methodology.storage: complete logical cache bytes, including free pages and retained snapshots; not peak disk
methodology.limitations: serial exploratory blocks, no randomized causal estimates; cache repair changes disposable metadata only, not project files; hosted CI not measured
